test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The researchers at which of the following institutes have designed and booted up India's first indigenously-developed microprocessor that can be used in mobile computing devices?
solution:
The correct answer is __**IIT Madras**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shakti **is the **first Microprocessor **In **India **which is **designed **and **developed by **the **students of IIT **(Indian Institute Of Technology) Chennai.
 
• It is **built **with a **microchip **that is **manufactured **or **created **at **ISRO **(Indian Space Research Organization) Chandigarh.
 
• **According to IIT-M**, the **Shakti microprocessor **can be used in **low-power wireless systems **and **networking systems **besides reducing **reliance **on **imported microprocessors **in the **communication and defense sectors**.
 
• The **Shakti family of processors **was **fabricated at Semi-Conductor Laboratory **(SCL), **Indian Space Research Organizations **(ISRO).
 
• **According to IIT-**M, the **Shakti processor family targets clock speeds **to suit **various end-user application devices **such as various **consumer electronic devices**, mobile **computing devices, **embedded **low-power wireless systems**, and **networking systems**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A **microprocessor **is a **computer processor **where the **data processing logic **and **control **are **included **on **a single integrated circuit **or a **small number of integrated circuits**.
 
• The **microprocessor **is a **multipurpose**, **clock-driven**, **register-based**, **digital integrated circuit **that accepts **binary data as input**, **processes **it according to **instructions stored in its memory**, and **provides results **(also in binary form) as **output**.
 
• Microprocessors contain **both combinational logic and sequential digital logic**.
